viewing_check: KEY CHECK: compare the lamp to genuine Barsony FL41 Drum Beat of Trinidad (figure, drum, palm leaf). Barsony originals often carry a paper label or incised mark; none visible on base. If genuine, worth several hundred; if a copy, the 'style' lookalike sold A$425. Photos viewed (3). KEY CHECK at viewing: turn the lamp over and look for any impressed or inked Barsony mark, FL41, a paper label or maker initials; none is visible in the 3 catalogue photos, so as shown it is an unmarked lamp of the Barsony type, and the current bid of A$130 against estimate A$180-250 already prices it as such. [Armitage page 8 Nov 2026: estimate $180-250, current bid $130. Photos viewed (about 400px, low resolution): 3 photos: black glazed girl with arms back, painted red/green/gold skirt and necklace, drum at hip, green/gold palm leaf behind, bulb socket at back; underside photo shows bare black base with two holes (cord and socket) and no stamp, label, ink mark or Barsony/FL41 mark visible]
